about: Contradictions planted in plain-text CarePath documents for manage.py document_review_pack. Each item replaces one line of one document, in memory only, with a value another CarePath document contradicts. A review finds it when a kept contradiction finding quotes the planted text, and links it when that finding's other side is quoted from a source named in others. The path is the file under documentation/demo/docs/ the label is tested against; document is its upload name, which is the source's title. Frozen: a new pack starts a new reference.

audit-retention-shortened.replace: | Audit events | Two years minimum, never deleted by application code |
